segments.text: Wait, I can explain.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: Explain what?
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: That my bed was too big for you
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: and you had to roll around with trash?
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Forgive me, strawberry.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: He told me that his marriage was already dead.
segments.speaker: Grape

segments.text: It's over, banana.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Keep the leftovers.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: I felt like I was suffocating.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Everything I built over 10 years was a paper lie.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Wow, look at this delicious strawberry.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: Don't leave me.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: That night I cried until I was dry.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: But it was the last tear I shed for him.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: If he wanted a new life, let him start from scratch.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Because in mine, he no longer existed.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Love broke.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Now it was time to pick up the pieces and use them as knives.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: The sad widow stayed at the hotel.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Today, today, the boss is born.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Banana forgot one small detail.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: The money, the companies and the power were always in my name.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Strawberry, please. You blocked my cards.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: My keys don't open the house. Let's talk.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: You've got the wrong office.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: Human resources is on the second floor.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: I just signed your dismissal.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: You can't do this to me.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: I helped you build this company.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: Watch us. Yes, I can.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: No, no, no, banana. What did you do?
segments.speaker: Grape

segments.text: My accounts are frozen.
segments.speaker: Grape

segments.text: Banana, answer me.
segments.speaker: Grape

segments.text: Strawberry cut off my funds from the secret account.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: If she checks the company's movements in the Bahamas, we are dead.
segments.speaker: Banana

segments.text: Tell me you found something, Apple.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: I know they're hiding more from me than dirty sheets.
segments.speaker: Strawberry

segments.text: You were right, Mrs. Strawberry.
segments.speaker: Apple

segments.text: The deception didn't start yesterday. It's been years.
segments.speaker: Apple

segments.text: Shell companies, international money transfers,
segments.speaker: Apple

segments.text: as well as life insurance policies in Grape's name.
segments.speaker: Apple

segments.text: They didn't just want to betray you, Strawberry.
segments.speaker: Apple

segments.text: Banana and Grape's plan was to leave you in ruins and eliminate you.
segments.speaker: Apple

segments.text: They actually wanted to kill me, you know.
segments.speaker: Strawberry
